scope: ET6 production rolling integration prerequisite: server validation of native successor acceptance
implemented: Validate acceptance before recording a workflow event, including when acceptance is the only rolling field supplied.
Require a delivered retained successor with the current predecessor hash and exact resident checkpoint association.
Check measured native acceptance tick, monotonic origin and elapsed time, stop watermark, committed boundary, positive lead and queue depth.
Reject acceptance claims carrying execution_started or terminal_eligible authority.

focused_test.negative: Altered predecessor, successor, checkpoint, timing, boundary, lead, queue depth, execution/terminal flags and clock rejected.

limitations: Database query responses are mocked; this does not prove PostgreSQL concurrency or live native delivery.
Accepted queue lease lifetime, production route mounting, public admission wiring and packaged qualification remain incomplete.
No live Minecraft execution, continuous movement capacity or latency is established by this fixture.
